title: `<-` is looser than arithmetic; ranges take arithmetic bounds
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.4.1: `out <- "a" + "b"` concatenates first; range_expr bounds are comparisons, so [1..3] has 2 elements.
